Name: Timers
Author: herix00
Description:
[heading]Description[/heading]
Timers shows when your crops and equipment will be ready. Hover over a supported building to see what’s ready to collect, when the next batch will finish, or how long your casks need to reach the next quality tier.
The panel groups matching items and separates what’s ready now from what’s still growing, processing, or aging. It adjusts to the contents, scrolls through longer lists, and changes its colors with the season.
[heading](Manual) Installation Instructions[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Download and extract the Timers ZIP into your
[code]Stardew Valley/mods[/code]folder. You should have a
[code]mods/Timers/manifest.json[/code]file after extraction.[/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI, load your farm, and hover over a supported building containing planted greenhouse crops or enabled equipment.[/*]
[/list]Casks, kegs, and preserves jars are enabled by default. If you have Generic Mod Config Menu installed, open [b]Options → Mod Options → Timers[/b] to enable more equipment or change the display. You can also edit
[code]config.json[/code]in the Timers folder after the first launch.[size=4][b] [/b][/size]
[heading]Main Features[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Harvest estimates.[/b] See when planted greenhouse crops will be ready as a date, days remaining, or both.[/*]
[*][b]Equipment countdowns.[/b] Check processing and ready items in supported interiors. Matching items are grouped with a count.[/*]
[*][b]Cask aging.[/b] See current quality and the time remaining until each upcoming quality tier, shown with Stardew Valley’s quality stars.[/*]
[*][b]Three display modes.[/b] [b]Full[/b] uses text for item details. [b]Mixed[/b] combines in-game sprites with item names. [b]Minimal[/b] uses sprites for item names while keeping counts, timing, and status visible.[/*]
[*][b]Building support.[/b] Check greenhouses, sheds, barns, coops, slime hutches, farmhouses, cabins, and their available cellars. Timers also supports selected Stardew Valley Expanded buildings and farm layouts, including the repaired Grandpa’s Shed.[/*]
[/list][heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]SMAPI 4.5.2 or later[/b][/*]
[*][b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] is optional and adds in-game settings.[/*]
[*][b]Stardew Valley Expanded[/b] is optional and enables support for its buildings and equipment.[/*]
[/list]This release was tested in singleplayer on PC.


[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
Shout out to Conny and Waggy for helping with the UI choices since I had no idea what I was doing regarding design choices...
